home.note: 2026 home: navy jersey, white numbers outlined in red, red-white-red shoulder stripes, PATRIOTS chest wordmark, Flying Elvis on the sleeves, silver pants with a red-navy-red stripe, navy socks, silver helmet with the red facemask

away.note: 2026 road: white jersey, navy numbers outlined white and red, red-navy-red shoulder stripes, navy PATRIOTS wordmark, Flying Elvis on the sleeves, navy pants with a red-white-red stripe, navy socks, the silver helmet

venue.notes: 2026 home venue: Gillette Stadium (the retail model is Gillette too). End zones unpainted with the PATRIOTS wordmark in white outlined in navy (2026 week 2 frames show white letters on the turf; INFERRED which word each end carries, the retail texture is shared by both ends). The midfield Flying Elvis is re-rendered from the official mark (same design as 2004); the HOME OF THE NEW ENGLAND PATRIOTS ribbon and the Gillette Stadium sign are unchanged since 2004 and stay retail. Fan banners carry 2026 players.
